title: Cover failed mixed evidence batches and duplicate association final-image fences
outcome: Regressions pin conservative durability for mixed live/compacted batch write failure and one exact final-image fence when multiple checks resolve to one observation.
acceptance: A failed shared batch with live and compacted rows leaves compacted revalidating set, preserves prior compacted durability flags and never reports the newly read proof as durably safe.
Two checks resolving to the same live observation under queued persistence produce one exact fence containing the final evidence image.
